adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff in app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js, the `addMembers` and `removeMember` functions both call `self.findMembers()` in their `.then()` callbacks but don't return the result. The `findMembers()` method returns a promise (Discourse.ajax call). If `findMembers()` fails after a successful add/remove, the outer promise from `addMembers`/`removeMember` will still resolve successfully because the inner promise rejection is not propagated. This means the UI would show success even though the member list refresh failed, leaving stale data displayed. This is a real bug - the promise chain is broken.
